name: HWR_WLNS_COACH_ASSIGNMENT
description: This table stores the coaching assignment request details.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the coaching assignments tables.

columns.name: COACH_ID
columns.description: This column indicates the id of the coach assigned for the record.

columns.name: COACHING_TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This column indicates the id of the coaching topic for which the coaching request is raised.

columns.name: COACHEE_PERSON_ID
columns.description: This column indicates the person id of the requester/coachee.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column indicates status of the coaching assignment record.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This column indicates the date at the beginning of coaching assignment with a coach.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This column indicates the date at the end of coaching assignment with a coach.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: This column is used to store the id of communication source.

columns.name: CONVERSATION_ID
columns.description: This column is used to store the id of conversation.
